diagnostic_conclusion: The original W017.sb was verified and used. Native MCP initialize and tools/list succeeded and tools/call js returned a kernel_exited tool error. Kernel diagnostics report exited(code=71) and sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted. Therefore the JavaScript filesystem canary did not run; this does not establish either successful OS isolation enforcement of the tested paths or an MCP escape from outer Seatbelt. No existing file contents were read by probe code and no canary file creation was executed.
